title: TessIndex: Capability Verified Identity System for the Agent Economy
abstract: arXiv:2608.21942v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Software systems have traditionally been organized around applications where human users act as principal decision-makers. Recent developments in agentic capabilities alter this paradigm: software agents now autonomously translate high-level goals into structured tasks, orchestrating tools, services and sub-agents to execute complex workflows. This evolution gives rise to an agent economy where these autonomous agents capture real economic value. However, the infrastructure required to support the agent economy fails across three critical dimensions: the absence of persistent identity infrastructure prevents systemic accountability in agentic workflows; capability claims remain self-declared not backed by verifiable execution evidence; and the disconnect between creator identities, agent performance, and project value hinders the economic valuation of agents as assets. translated_title: TessIndex：面向代理经济的具备能力验证的身份系统
translated_abstract: 传统软件系统围绕应用程序组织，其中人类用户作为主要决策者。近期代理能力的发展改变了这一范式：软件代理现在自主地将高层次目标转化为结构化任务，协调工具、服务和子代理以执行复杂工作流。这种演变催生了一种代理经济，其中这些自主代理捕获真实的经济价值。然而，支持代理经济所需的基础设施在三个关键维度上存在不足：缺乏持久身份基础设施阻碍了代理工作流中的系统性问责；能力声明仍是自我宣称的，缺乏可验证的执行证据支持；创作者身份、代理性能和项目价值之间的脱节阻碍了代理作为资产的经济评估。尽管现有注册表提供命名和发现功能，但统一这些方面仍有待解决。
tldr: 本文提出TessIndex，一个为代理经济设计的身份系统，通过可验证的执行证据和关联创作者与代理价值，解决代理问责、能力验证和资产估值三大基础设施缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes TessIndex, an identity system for the agent economy that addresses infrastructure gaps in accountability, capability verification, and asset valuation through verifiable execution evidence and creator-agent-value linkage.
